text:
maria-partnereng: Heads up — kicking off CloudCo marketplace onboarding for reference architectures and Terraform modules. Need final owners for ref-arch docs, sample templates, and module CI. Office hours Thu 10am PT. Who can own the templates path?
aj-platform: I can help own the ref-arch docs, and the example manifests. +1 for Thu.
kevin-templates: I'll take the Terraform modules and module registry setup. Will draft a module README template.
lisa-qa: I'll coordinate ci/cd smoke tests. Do we have a test harness?
infra-eng: we've got a lightweight infra sandbox we can share (gcp project + creds). I'll post instructions.
maria-partnereng: @infra-eng please post the sandbox invite link here.
infra-eng: invite link: https://console.cloud.example.com/projects/partner-sandbox (shared with CloudCo SSO). Token expiry: 7 days.
kevin-templates: sample usage snippet:
```hcl
module "redwood_inference_refkit" {
  source = "git::https://github.com/redwood/refkit//terraform/modules/refkit"
  region = var.region
  instance_type = "n1-standard-8"
}
```
kevin-templates: We'll follow semantic versioning for modules. Looking to publish to registry by next Wed.
sam-sales: FYI we'll announce this during partner webinar on Mar 31 — need stable links and quickstart by then.
maria-partnereng: noted. Priority: README quickstart, CI smoke, sample app + cost estimate.
lisa-qa: Can we add an automated perf smoke that runs a generation sample? I can add a GH action.
aj-platform: I can add the GH action template. We'll also add a configuration example for Redwood runtime options: batching/quantization toggles.
kevin-templates: Question: any constraints on modules supporting both AWS and GCP? We should avoid provider-specific resources in core module.
infra-eng: Agree — keep core provider-agnostic. Use thin provider wrappers for cloud-specific bits.
marketplace-bot: Reminder: Partner onboarding checklist updated -> https://confluence.redwood.ai/partner-onboard (section: templates)
maria-partnereng: Great. @kevin-templates @lisa-qa @aj-platform please confirm ownership by EOD Tue. If no response, we'll assign by rotation.
sam-sales: I'll sync with marketing on the webinar page and sample screenshots.
kevin-templates: Confirmed. I'll open a tracking GH issue and link it here.
maria-partnereng: Thanks all — see you Thu office hours. :tada:
